test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If L × M means that L is the mother of M, L + M means that L is the father of M, and L ÷ M means that L is the sister of M, then which of the following expression shows that P is the father of R?
solution:
Let us first decode the symbols and then draw a family tree :

 
 

 Symbol
 Meaning
 
 

 ×
 Mother
 
 

 +
 Father
 
 

 ÷
 Sister
 
 

Family tree is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b1d977930a5ae8ff2ad87e3b6407517b08dce70e8f045c243365162391bc53.png] 

Drawing the Family tree as per the given information :

1) P + Q ÷ R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8165c2d9de7bbf460d26ffdaec003ecb00a2e75a87fec36552fab809e174df5.png] 

2) P ÷ R + Q 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1421bdb8c870f41a6bcbf179eb23f529b691aef6dec7ea1e0291ab1a98349cb7.png] 

3) Q + P ÷ R 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bce141ca362156a2ec09a4dfddb0a9617440814ef26fedd205ca242234d0fc0.png] 

4) P + Q × R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/598414b10060e020f6f05d5f5ccc45cbf478e3d9de1a808e836a20c93bcbb49b.png] 

Only first impression shows that** P is the father of R.**

Hence, the **correct answer** is **"Option 1".**
